cues.text: Hello, is this John Murphy?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Hi, yes it is.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Hi John, this is Ed Heisenburg from the Wild Dunes Spa and Resort calling about your application for our lifeguard position.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Do you have a few minutes to talk?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Yes, absolutely
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Great. Could you give me your address?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Sure. My address is 45 Elsinore Court.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: I’m sorry, was that Eleanor? Could you spell that for me?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Sure - it’s Elsinore. E-L-S-I-N-O-R-E.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Okay, thanks. And is this the number we should reach you at in the future? 099885767?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: No, this is my home phone, but let me give you my mobile phone number instead: 077896245. Call me on that one.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Okay - I’ll make a note of that. Could you tell me your availability?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Sure. I am usually available during afternoons or weekends.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: I would prefer not to be scheduled on weeknights because I work part-time as a waiter.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: That shouldn’t be a problem, since we don’t stay open very late anyway. And do you have any other employment experience?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Yes, I have worked at a few other places. I was the baseball coach at Ridgemont High School last season.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: I see. And do you have any other experience that you would like us to note on your application?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Yes. Last year I worked at the beach as a rescue diver.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Rescue diver? That sounds intense!
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Well, it’s really just like being a lifeguard, except in the ocean instead of a pool. So kind if like being a lifeguard at the world’s largest pool.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Haha. I see.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: So could you tell me about the relevant skills you have? I’m guessing a lot, given your experience.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: I am CPR certified and have 2 years of diving experience.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Great! It sounds like you are well qualified for this position. When does your CPR certification expire?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Hm. I think in November, but let me quickly check my CPR card… actually, it expires in October.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Okay, so regardless you have it through the end of the summer. When is your ideal time to work?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Since I work in the restaurant on weeknights, I like weekends best - specifically Saturday mornings.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: I see. We do already have a lot of staff available on Saturdays, but I do need an early morning shift lifeguard.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: How early could you work Saturday morning?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: I can get there by 6.00 if need be.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: You’ll be happy to know we open a little later than that, but I’ll put you down for Saturday morning here.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Oh awesome! I can’t wait to get started.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: How about you come in next Saturday, the 12th?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: That sounds good.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: Great - We can figure out other shifts for you to work when you come in then. One last thing - just out of curiosity, where did you hear about us?
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: I heard your ad on the radio while I was driving this morning.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: You know, I think you’re the first person who has responded to our radio ads.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: It’s almost always people who have seen us in the newspaper.
cues.speaker: Employer

cues.text: Yeah, I don’t have time to read through the newspaper every morning.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: I have plenty of time in the car to listen to radio ads.
cues.speaker: Applicant

cues.text: That makes sense. Well, thanks for your time, and we’ll look forward to seeing you on the 12th.
cues.speaker: Employer
